solution_summary: Gojob used Azure OpenAI Service, Power Platform to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. Founder Pascal Lorne and Product Manager Thibaut Watrigant are behind this cutting-edge innovation, which they told us all about.
